title: Parimala and Co
description: Follows a family who, after committing murder, must navigate the predicament they face while trying to maintain their everyday lives.

title: Sherlock Holmes A Game Of Shadows
description: Detective Sherlock Holmes is on the trail of criminal mastermind Professor Moriarty, who is carrying out a string of random crimes across Europe.

title: Double Occupancy
description: Rajini transforms between woman by day and man by night, hiding this gender swap from partners creating tangled complications.

title: Balti
description: In a border town where kabaddi reigns supreme, four champion players dominate both the sport and the streets. When personal rivalries and dangerous feuds emerge, their unbreakable brotherhood faces its greatest test.

title: Peddi
description: Peddi struggles to secure official recognition for his marginalized village against systemic oppression and physical ruin, ultimately finding redemption through a grueling transition into a world-class para track athlete

title: Pati Patni Aur Woh Do
description: Prajapati sees his orderly life unravel after helping a young couple evade a powerful politician, triggering a cascade of mistaken identities, public scandals, and increasingly absurd suspicions that threaten his marriage to Aparna.

title: Ek Din
description: Dinesh loves his colleague Meera, but can't confess his feelings. During a company trip, Dinesh makes a wish under a magical bell for Meera to become his girlfriend for a day and his wish comes true.
